| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `li` | `enum(2)` | `0` (no_warning) |   | Leap indicator (3 = clock unsynchronized). |

| `stratum` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | Stratum (0 = unspecified, 1 = primary reference, 2-15 = secondary). |
| `poll` | `int(8)` | `6` |   | Maximum poll interval, log2 seconds (signed). |
| `precision` | `int(8)` | `-20` |   | Clock precision, log2 seconds (signed). |
| `root_delay` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Round-trip delay to the reference clock (16.16 fixed point seconds). |
| `root_dispersion` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Dispersion to the reference clock (16.16 fixed point seconds). |
| `reference_id` | `bytes(4)` | `00 00 00 00` |   | Reference ID (ASCII code for stratum 1, else an IPv4 address or hash). |
| `reference_ts` | `uint(64)` | `0` |   | Time the system clock was last set (64-bit NTP timestamp). |
| `origin_ts` | `uint(64)` | `0` |   | Client transmit time echoed by the server (64-bit NTP timestamp). |
| `receive_ts` | `uint(64)` | `0` |   | Time the request arrived at the server (64-bit NTP timestamp). |
| `transmit_ts` | `uint(64)` | `0` |   | Time the packet left the sender (64-bit NTP timestamp). |
